Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood + Zenith Systems

Hi Sam / Lena —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Per our conversation I'm attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get us aligned on milestones, owners, and a target close date. High level: Zenith wants predictable, low-latency search/assistant in production and is prioritizing data isolation and strong auditability. We captured the key dependencies and suggested owners below.

Attachment: [Redwood_MAP_Draft_ZenithSystems_v1.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)]

Two timeline options (pick one or propose an alternative):
- Option A: Accelerated (4 weeks) — aggressive: Discovery complete in 1 week, SSO + networking first, pilot integration in 2-3 weeks, procurement/contracting parallel. Target close: 2026-08-25.
- Option B: Standard (8 weeks) — recommended for most customers to allow security review and any legal redlines: Target close: 2026-09-22.

Draft milestones & responsibilities (high level):
1) Finalize MAP & stakeholders — Sam / Lena (Zenith), Marissa (Redwood) — due in 3 business days
2) Security & compliance questionnaire / evidence (SOC2, retention, KMS) — Zenith Sec Review Lead (TBD) + Redwood Security (Aditya) — due by Week 2 (for accelerated)
3) Network & infra (VPC peering, IP allowlist) — Zenith Cloud Eng (Rajiv) + Redwood Infra (Aditya) — due by Week 2-3
4) Pilot integration (test dataset, API keys, perf validation) — Zenith Eng + Redwood SE — Week 3-4
5) Procurement/contracting & PO — Zenith Procurement (Marta) + Redwood Contracts (David) — ongoing; aim to complete by pilot-to-production cutover
6) Production launch & runbook handoff — joint

Open items / dependencies we flagged on the call: SSO method (SAML vs OIDC), VPC peering window, expected QPS and P95 latency targets, and data retention policy.

Ask: Please confirm (a) the right internal stakeholders we should list on the MAP, (b) preferred timeline (Option A/Option B/other), and (c) any must-have procurement dates we should accommodate.

Once you confirm, I'll update the attached MAP and we can schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff to lock owners and dates.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Confirmed stakeholders: me (Sam), Lena (Head of Product), Rajiv Malhotra (CTO) — please add Rajiv (rajiv.malhotra@zenithsystems.com) to the MAP. Procurement/PO owner is Marta Gomez (marta.gomez@zenithsystems.com) — cc'ing her on procurement threads will help.
- Timeline: we'd like to aim for something between your options. 6 weeks would be ideal for us (commercial and security cycles are a little tight but doable). So please treat this as "Option A (accelerated) but with a 2-week security buffer" — target close ~2026-09-01.
- Dependencies: Rajiv noted we need a short SSO design doc and a network peering window; procurement needs an SOW estimate by Aug 5 to make our next PO cycle.

Can you add Rajiv and Marta to the MAP and share an updated timeline? Also happy to do the 30-min kickoff next week after you update.

Best,
